options.content:
**Start here:** check whether any service recorded an error in the previous hour, then compare traffic, latency, and error trends. Open the service graph for topology and edge health, or use a panel link to continue in Explore.

**Signal sources:** application and trace-generated metrics are in **AMP**; traces are in **Tempo**. The health cards report observed error spans only. **No errors** means no error span was recorded in the fixed one-hour lookback; it does not prove availability, traffic, or complete instrumentation. The browser has no Faro/RUM coverage.

options.content: **Fixed one-hour lookback:** green = no `STATUS_CODE_ERROR` span observed; red = one or more error spans observed. The result is independent of the dashboard time picker. A green card is an error-presence indicator, not an availability or telemetry-freshness SLO.

panels.description: Binary error-presence indicator over the fixed previous hour, derived from Tempo span metrics in AMP. No errors does not prove availability or telemetry completeness.

targets.expr: 100 * ((sum by (service) (rate(traces_spanmetrics_calls_total{source="tempo",deployment_environment="aws-demo",service=~"movie-(reservation-(service|agent|mcp|web)|recommendation-(service|mcp))",status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"}[2m]))) or (0 * sum by (service) (rate(traces_spanmetrics_calls_total{source="tempo",deployment_environment="aws-demo",service=~"movie-(reservation-(service|agent|mcp|web)|recommendation-(service|mcp))"}[2m])))) / clamp_min(sum by (service) (rate(traces_spanmetrics_calls_total{source="tempo",deployment_environment="aws-demo",service=~"movie-(reservation-(service|agent|mcp|web)|recommendation-(service|mcp))"}[2m])), 1e-9)
